title: mcp-config — IS OVERLAY v2 (authored by Intent Solutions)
description: The Intent-Solutions-only delta on top of upstream-base/mcp-config.v2.json. THIS FILE IS THE ONLY PLACE IS POLICY LIVES for this contract. The DR-062 explicit transport and environment declarations remain required for every server, together with description, strict-SemVer version and boolean enabled. Under bead bd_000-projects-709y, command and args are required only for stdio (or an absent selector); URL transports require url, matching the upstream base. The optional metadata extension remains IS-owned. The overlay only adds requirements and narrows constraints relative to the upstream base (DR-044 D7); it never removes an upstream requirement.
$comment: OVERLAY REQUIRED DELTA beyond the base floor [name]: [type, env, description, version, enabled], plus conditional requiredness: stdio requires [command, args]; http/streamable-http/sse/ws require [url]. This proposal retires the DR-062 flat command/args promotion for URL transports under bd_000-projects-709y. Explicit type and env remain required, and all supplied fields retain their base type and value constraints. Required-field policy changes require approval before landing; this proposal does not record ratification. Citations: DR-062; code.claude.com/docs/en/mcp.

type.$comment: IS: RELOCATED narrowing (DR-062 Class 2, 056 #1) — promoted from upstream-optional (the documented stdio default) to IS-required: a published IS marketplace artifact declares its transport explicitly rather than relying on the implicit default. The enum and wire forms are the base's; the overlay adds only the required-membership. CONVERGENCE TRIGGER: if the upstream documents `type` as required on the per-server entry (the standardized format example carries it), move the required-membership to upstream-base.

command.$comment: IS: required for stdio (or an absent selector), matching the upstream base. The former DR-062 flat promotion is retired for URL transports by the 709y proposal. The base owns type and non-emptiness. CONVERGENCE TRIGGER: if upstream requires command for all transport types, move the unconditional requirement into the base.

args.$comment: IS: every stdio entry declares its argument vector, [] when none. Optional for URL transports; the base still validates supplied values as arrays of strings. CONVERGENCE TRIGGER: if upstream requires args for stdio entries, move this conditional requirement into the base.

env.$comment: IS: RELOCATED narrowing (DR-062 Class 2, 056 #1) — promoted from upstream-optional to IS-required (the corpus's flat all-required projection choice: every published entry declares its environment surface, {} when none). The object type is the base's; the overlay adds only the required-membership. CONVERGENCE TRIGGER: if the upstream documents `env` as required on the per-server entry, move the required-membership to upstream-base.

description.$comment: IS: net-new IS-required tracking field, carried from the v1 overlay (the `.mcp.json` server entry has no description key; the IS marketplace tier requires every published artifact to describe itself — the universal disclosureMarkers fold caps its length). CONVERGENCE TRIGGER: if the upstream adds a required server `description`, move the required-membership to upstream-base.

version.$comment: IS: net-new IS-required tracking field, carried from the v1 overlay, NARROWED to strict SemVer 2.0.0 (the `.mcp.json` entry carries no version). Mirrors the version tracking field every IS authoring contract carries. CONVERGENCE TRIGGER: if the upstream adds a required server `version`, move the required-membership (and/or pattern) to upstream-base.

enabled.$comment: IS: net-new IS-required operational field, carried from the v1 overlay (whether the server is active; must be a real boolean, not the string 'true'). CONVERGENCE TRIGGER: Claude Code's marketplace `defaultEnabled` is the nearest upstream analog; if the per-server entry gains a required boolean enablement field, move the required-membership to upstream-base.

metadata.$comment: IS: RELOCATED kernel-only extension object (DR-062 Class 3 prose — the generic vendor-namespaced `metadata` object, e.g. metadata.intent-solutions, has ZERO upstream provenance, so under the documented-fields-only base rule it lives in the overlay). Optional; must be an object when present. CONVERGENCE TRIGGER: if the upstream documents a top-level `metadata` field for the per-server entry, move it to upstream-base.

allOf.$comment: Transport-sensitive presence (709y): URL transports use url; the stdio default uses command and an explicit args vector. The composed tier still requires an explicit type.
